In California from 2021 to 2025, 8.4% of all reported serious violent crimes were committed by youth under 18.

Unit: this percentage is of offenders recorded in NIBRS reports (including offenders recorded with an unknown age), not of crimes or incidents; one incident can list several offenders, and not every offender is identified or recorded.

Definition: NIBRS violent crime is reported here using the UCR-aligned set: murder/nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault.

Note: This data comes from the FBI's NIBRS program. Not all agencies report to this system, and some may have incomplete data — especially in their first year of NIBRS reporting or for recent months of data. Always verify that reported offenses are not impacted by incomplete coverage.
